es: Escribir sobre un problema local (agua, basura o calor) con una estructura de grado, su resultado y una solución.

teaching.en: There is such a shortage of water that the neighbourhood has none in the afternoon.
teaching.es: Hay una escasez de agua tan grande que el barrio se queda sin agua por la tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Such a + sustantivo + that + resultado: un problema con su consecuencia.
segments: There is such a shortage of water that
the neighbourhood has none in the afternoon.
teaching.audioText: There is such a shortage of water that the neighbourhood has none in the afternoon.

teaching.en: The dust from the road is so thick that we cannot open the windows.
teaching.es: El polvo del camino es tan denso que no podemos abrir las ventanas.
teaching.explanationEs: So + adjetivo + that + frase: el resultado es una acción concreta.
segments: The dust from the road is so
thick that we cannot open the windows.
teaching.audioText: The dust from the road is so thick that we cannot open the windows.

teaching.en: The streets are too hot for children to play, so the neighbourhood needs more shade.
teaching.es: Las calles son demasiado calurosas para que jueguen los niños, así que el barrio necesita más sombra.
teaching.explanationEs: Too + adjetivo + for + persona + to + verbo; so añade la consecuencia.
segments: The streets are too hot for children to
play, so the neighbourhood needs more shade.
teaching.audioText: The streets are too hot for children to play, so the neighbourhood needs more shade.

teaching.en: The problem gets worse every summer, but we can solve it.
teaching.es: El problema empeora cada verano, pero podemos resolverlo.
teaching.explanationEs: Un texto también dice si el problema crece (worse) y que tiene solución.
segments: The problem gets worse every summer,
teaching.audioText: The problem gets worse every summer, but we can solve it.

teaching.en: I suggest a simple plan: the council should improve the drains.
teaching.es: Sugiero un plan sencillo: el ayuntamiento debería mejorar los desagües.
teaching.explanationEs: Para cerrar, una solución con I suggest o should + verbo.
segments: I suggest a simple plan: the
teaching.audioText: I suggest a simple plan: the council should improve the drains.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El polvo es tan denso que cerramos las ventanas.»

answer.text: The dust is so thick that we close the windows.

feedback.es: So thick es el problema y that we close the windows es el resultado.

hint.es: Problema con so + adjetivo; el resultado empieza con that.

prompt.es: Completa: «El parque está demasiado caluroso para que jueguen los niños.»

feedback.es: Demasiado + adjetivo + for + persona + to + verbo se construye con too.

origin.text: The park is ___ hot for children to play.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase propone una solución con suggest?

choices.text: I suggest to plant more trees.

feedback.es: Después de suggest se usa un verbo en -ing: I suggest planting.

hint.es: Tras suggest va un verbo terminado en -ing.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que falta en el texto: el resultado del problema.

choices.text: As a result, many houses have no water.
As a result, the council should change them.
However, the pipes are very old.

feedback.es: Falta el resultado: sin tuberías en buen estado, muchas casas se quedan sin agua.

origin.text: The pipes in our street are old. ___ The council should change them.

prompt.es: Completa las dos frases con la estructura de grado correcta.

feedback.es: La primera frase lleva that + resultado (so); la segunda, for + persona + to + verbo (too).

sentences: The problem is ___ serious that we need a plan.
The heat is ___ strong for old people to go out.
origin.text: «El problema es tan serio que necesitamos un plan.» «El calor es demasiado fuerte para que salgan los mayores.»

prompt.es: Escribe una frase con such: el polvo es un problema muy grande.

answer.text: The dust is such a big problem.
accepted: The dust is such a big problem.
The dust is such a serious problem.

feedback.es: Para decir «un problema tan grande» se usa such a big problem: such a + adjetivo + sustantivo singular.

origin.text: Datos: el polvo (dust) — un problema muy grande.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué solución propone la persona.

choices.text: The school should close the windows.
The council should clean the road every week.
The children should stay at home.

feedback.es: La frase «I suggest that the council cleans it» es la solución: limpiar el camino cada semana.

origin.audio: The road near my school is so full of dust that we cannot open the windows. I suggest that the council cleans it every week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El calor es un problema tan grande que nadie juega fuera.»

answer.text: The heat is such a big problem that nobody plays outside.

feedback.es: Such a big problem es adjetivo + sustantivo singular, y that nobody plays outside da el resultado.

prompt.es: Completa: «El barrio es tan ruidoso que nadie puede dormir.»

feedback.es: Noisy es un adjetivo solo: so noisy that… expresa el resultado.

origin.text: The neighbourhood is ___ noisy that nobody can sleep.

prompt.es: Escribe un párrafo: problema con so o such, su resultado y una solución.

answer.text: The water shortage in my neighbourhood is so serious that many houses have no water in the afternoon. It is such a big problem that families cannot cook. As a result, the children cannot play outside. I suggest fixing the pipes, and the council should start this month.
accepted: The water shortage in my neighbourhood is so serious that many houses have no water in the afternoon. It is such a big problem that families cannot cook. As a result, the children cannot play outside. I suggest fixing the pipes, and the council should start this month.

Our neighbourhood has such a serious water shortage that many houses have no water. The pipes are so old that the water is dirty. As a result, the children cannot play outside. The council should fix the pipes, and I suggest cleaning the drains.

feedback.es: Un buen texto junta un problema con estructura de grado, su resultado con that o as a result y una solución con suggest o should.

origin.text: Problema: la escasez de agua (water shortage) en tu barrio es muy seria y muchas casas no tienen agua. Resultado: los niños no pueden jugar fuera. Solución: arreglar las tuberías (pipes).

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une bien el problema con su resultado?

choices.text: The shade is so small to sit in.
The shade is too small that we sit in the sun.
The shade is so small that we sit in the sun.

feedback.es: So small that + frase expresa el resultado; too pide to + verbo, y so no va con to.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué proponen los padres.

choices.text: Moving the playground to the school.

feedback.es: Los padres sugieren plantar árboles en el patio de juegos.

origin.audio: The playground is too hot at noon because it has no trees. The parents suggest planting some.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase con too: hace demasiado calor para jugar en el parque.

answer.text: It is too hot to play in the park.
accepted: It is too hot to play in the park.
It is too hot for us to play in the park.
It is too hot to play in the park today.

feedback.es: Demasiado calor para jugar se dice too hot to play: too antes del adjetivo y to + verbo base.

origin.text: Frase: hace demasiado calor para jugar en el parque hoy.
